title: Gaps shape the plant
alt_text: A potted plant diagram marks three distinct cyan negative-space shapes between its leaves. Matching A, B, and C labels link each opening to an enlarged example that can be compared by width, angle, and position.
caption: Three different gaps share edges with the surrounding leaves.
